description: Pinned external posse case t1222 head 4210ed17.
intent: fix(relaunch): keep a passed Review when relaunching with the same Profile on an unchanged head

expected.defect: TestSameProfileRelaunchKeepsCandidateAndReviewPass never invokes the relaunch operation. It only calls relaunchNeedsPlanRevision and then reads the unchanged fixture state, so it passes even if an actual same-profile relaunch revises the plan, replaces the candidate, or invalidates the Review pass.
